title: Fennic halts deliveries after brake pad batch failure (simulated)
text: SIMULATED DOCUMENT. All names, events and figures are invented for the demo. Fennic Railway Brakes suspended deliveries of rail brake pads from production batch 2026-04 on 6 July 2026 after three operators reported cracks in pads during routine inspections. A company spokesperson confirmed that about 14,000 pads were affected and that the company is offering free replacement. No accident has been reported. Industry analysts said the recall is a heavy burden for a company that already reported a loss for 2025.
